_readme: The Paddock store's product list. Run `node scripts/build-store.mjs` after any change: it writes the category and product pages and the category tiles on paddock.html. Prices here are what checkout charges: the store Worker builds its catalog from this file (price = site price, map = minimum advertised price, list = the maker's list price/MSRP, for reference only; checkoutNote = the line under the item in Stripe). Dealer cost never goes in this file (the repo is public): it lives in the store database, set in Pitwall -> Products. A price change deploys automatically when pushed to main. Product lifecycle: optional 'status' is 'live' (default), 'coming-soon' (shown, not sold) or 'retired' (hidden from the store, page kept as no longer available; optional 'replacedBy' = slug of the replacement). Never delete a product: retire it. External products link out and never enter the cart. Product pages live at /paddock/products/<slug>/ whatever the category; when a product changes category, add the old one to 'pastCategories' so its old address keeps redirecting. Brands: products sold through the cart need a 'brand'; each brand gets a page at /paddock/brands/<brand>/ unless a category holds exactly its products, and a 'Shop by brand' row appears on paddock.html once there are two brands (optional 'blurb' and 'intro' per brand under 'brands').

Tuff Jug.mapPolicy: MAP is 15% below MSRP. It covers the website, social, email, Google Shopping, flyers, event signage and published promo codes. It does not cover prices shown only in a cart or checkout, private in-person prices, or free shipping.

VIM Tools.mapPolicy: MAP is listed per part in VIM's 2026 WMI price file (effective 05/01/2026), about 73% of the User (list) price. The written policy (what it covers: website, Google Shopping, events, promo codes) is still to get from the VIM rep.

products.name: Tuff Jug 5 Gallon Utility Jug
products.desc: Five gallons with the Auto-Stop Spout, internal venting and a clear view strip for fast, controlled pours.
products.about: The 5 gallon Tuff Jug is the jug in the 799 trailer: multi-layer HDPE, a 1 in NPT spout thread and a clear view strip so you can see the level without opening it. It comes with the Auto-Stop Spout, which vents internally and stops the pour when the tank is full. Swap in the Black Ripper Cap for maximum flow, or the flexible Tuff Spout for awkward fillers.
facts: Multi-layer HDPE, 1 in NPT spout thread
products.fine: Utility container. Not a certified portable fuel container.
products.idNote: 5 gallon jugs are the view-strip (VS) models.

products.name: Tuff Jug Electric Transfer Pump
products.desc: Hands-free transfer with one button and automatic shutoff. Includes the Tuff Jug adapter. Fits current Tuff Jugs.
products.about: Battery electric transfer pump with automatic shutoff, so you can fill without lifting a full jug over the car. One button to run, and it stops itself when the tank is full. Includes the Tuff Jug adapter and fits current Tuff Jugs.
facts: 21 in intake hose, 51 in discharge hose
4 AA batteries (not included), up to 250 gal per set

images.alt: Tuff Jug Electric Transfer Pump with intake and discharge hoses
Tuff Jug Electric Transfer Pump hoses laid out

products.name: Tuff Jug Black Ripper Cap, 5 Gallon
products.desc: Tuff Jug's maximum-flow pour cap. Swaps onto any 5 gallon Tuff Jug in place of the Auto-Stop Spout.
products.about: The Ripper Cap is Tuff Jug's maximum-flow pour cap. It threads onto any 5 gallon Tuff Jug in place of the Auto-Stop Spout when you want the jug empty fast.

images.alt: Black Ripper Cap on a 5 gallon Tuff Jug

products.name: Tuff Jug Tuff Spout with Auto Stop, 5 Gallon
products.desc: Flexible hose spout with Auto Stop. Stays flexible from −22°F to 200°F and won't yellow, harden or crack.
products.about: A flexible hose spout with Auto Stop for 5 gallon Tuff Jugs, for fillers the stock spout can't reach. It stays flexible from −22°F to 200°F, with a nitrile inner layer, a UV and weather resistant outer layer, internal venting and a multi O-ring seal.
facts: Nitrile inner layer, UV-resistant outer layer
Auto Stop, internal venting, multi O-ring seal

images.alt: Tuff Jug Tuff Spout flexible hose spout with Auto Stop
Tuff Spout fitted to a 5 gallon Tuff Jug

products.checkoutNote: Holds the Tuff Spout in a bend
products.name: Tuff Jug Spout Bender
products.desc: A curved clip that holds the flexible Tuff Spout in a bend, so the pour lands where the filler is.
products.about: The Spout Bender is a rigid curved clip from Tuff Jug. Press the flexible Tuff Spout into its open channel and it holds the hose in a set bend, for fillers that sit at an awkward angle.
facts: Pairs with the flexible Tuff Spout

images.alt: Tuff Jug Spout Bender curved clip, front view
Tuff Jug Spout Bender showing the open channel that holds the spout hose

products.checkoutNote: 3/8 in drive, 90 tooth flex head, made in USA
products.name: VIM MVRK 3/8" Drive Flex Head Ratchet, 12", Made in USA
products.desc: VIM's American-made MVRK flex head ratchet: 3/8 in drive, a 90-tooth head that needs only 4 degrees of swing, 12 in long.
products.about: MVRK is VIM's made-in-USA ratchet line. The FR6USA is the 3/8 in drive flex head version: the head pivots to reach fasteners at an angle, the fine 90-tooth gear ratchets with only 4 degrees of handle swing, and the 12 in polished chrome body gives you leverage on stubborn bolts. VIM sells a repair kit for it (R6USA-RK), so a worn mechanism gets rebuilt rather than replaced.
facts: Made in USA, VIM limited lifetime warranty

images.alt: VIM Tools MVRK FR6USA 3/8 in drive 12 in flex head ratchet, made in USA
Close-up of the MVRK FR6USA flex head with the VIM MVRK USA stamp and direction lever

products.checkoutNote: 17mm hex, VW gearbox fill and drain plugs, made in USA
products.name: VIM V410 17mm Hex VW Drain Plug Tool, Made in USA
products.desc: The 17mm hex tool for the fill and drain plugs on VW manual gearboxes. American-made by VIM.
products.about: VW put 17mm internal hex fill and drain plugs on its manual gearboxes, from air-cooled Beetles through the Scirocco and Golf, and most socket sets don't have a hex that size. The VIM V410 is a solid 17mm hex made for exactly that job, so a gear oil change doesn't start with a trip to three parts stores.
facts: 17mm hex for VW manual gearbox fill and drain plugs
Made in USA by VIM Tools

images.alt: VIM V410 17mm hex VW drain plug tool, black oxide finish
